title: Own-time answer and GitHub comment pickup skill
story: This adds the agent behind own-time answering. 'With a grilling agent' on the own-time screen now starts a real chat that settles the ticket and closes or releases it on Done. It also adds /grillo-answer pickup, which turns answers members wrote as GitHub comments into recorded answers; the Tickets tab's 'Pick up GitHub comments' button starts it. Nothing earlier is removed.

checks.criterion: Done with every question answered posts a decision, closes the ticket, adds its Settled line, then applies the map-done rule
checks.steps: Open a made-up test project with one open ticket that has two questions. On the own-time screen choose 'With a grilling agent', answer both questions in the chat, press Done.
checks.expected: Each question shows Answered; answer comments cite new own-time-answer sources; a decision comment; the ticket is closed and under Settled. If it was the last open ticket and there is no fog, /grillo-prd starts in the same agent.

checks.criterion: Done with questions still open returns the ticket to the pool, unlocked
checks.steps: As above, but answer only the first question, then press Done.
checks.expected: The ticket stays open with no assignee and no decision; the agent names the open question by code and stops.

checks.criterion: Plain GitHub comments become answers marked via: github, naming who recorded them, even on a ticket someone else holds
checks.steps: Member B takes a one-question ticket and writes the answer as a plain comment in GitHub's web app. Member A runs /grillo-answer pickup.
checks.expected: A new source holds B's comment word for word (who: B, when: the comment date, where: GitHub comment <id> on ticket #N). The answer comment has who: A, via: github and from: <id>. The ticket closes with a via: github decision and stays assigned to B. A comment that answers no question stays as it is.
